title: Working From Home
summary: Ama and Carlos compare the good and bad sides of working from home and share tips to stay focused.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: split scene with Ama at a tidy home desk with a laptop and Carlos in a busy office, plants and a window, no text

sentences.text: Hello and welcome back! Today we are talking about working from home.
I have worked from home for two years now, and I have mixed feelings.
Me too. The best part is that I save two hours of travelling every day.
That is true. I also enjoy having lunch in my own kitchen.
But what about the downsides? I sometimes feel lonely.
Yes, that is my biggest problem. I miss chatting with my colleagues.
And it is difficult to separate work from free time.
Exactly. Last week I answered emails at eleven o'clock at night.
That sounds unhealthy. Did your manager ask you to do that?
No, nobody asked me. I simply could not stop thinking about work.
So we need some clear rules for ourselves.

quiz.q: What is a benefit Ama mentions?
quiz.explain: She saves two hours of travelling every day.
He misses chatting with his colleagues.

quiz.q: Why did Carlos answer emails at night?
options: He could not stop thinking about work
He was in a different country
quiz.explain: Nobody asked him; he simply could not stop thinking about work.

sentences.text: So, Ama, what rules do you follow?
First, I have a special corner for work, and I never work on the sofa.
That is smart. For me, getting dressed in proper clothes helps a lot.
Really? I thought pyjamas were the main benefit!
Ha! They are comfortable, but they make me feel lazy.
I also set a timer and take a short break every hour.
Good idea. I try to go for a walk at lunchtime.
And I turn off my work notifications after six o'clock.
I should try that. It would improve my sleep, too.
Also, plan a coffee with a friend once a week to avoid feeling lonely.
Great tips. Thanks for listening, and see you next time!

quiz.q: Where does Ama do her work?
quiz.explain: She has a special corner and never works on the sofa.

quiz.q: What does Carlos do to feel ready for work?
quiz.explain: Getting dressed in proper clothes helps him a lot.

quiz.q: What does Ama turn off after six o'clock?
quiz.explain: She turns off her work notifications after six o'clock.
